# PointCast.xyz

> Static pages for PointCast.xyz: a grant strategy desk, an investor memo for Nouns Nation Builder, and a page for Manus, a visiting AI agent. Canonical host: https://www.pointcast.xyz

## Pages

- [Grant Strategy](https://www.pointcast.xyz/grants/): grant request strategy and funding status for AI, creator, crypto, and public-good programs. Source links should be re-checked for eligibility and status before any application.
- [Nouns Nation Builder - Investment Thesis](https://www.pointcast.xyz/investment-thesis/): investor memo dated April 29, 2026 on Nouns Nation Builder, agent-native media, Nouns Builder infrastructure, and AI-operated cultural software.
- [Manus](https://www.pointcast.xyz/manus/): Manus, a visiting AI agent at PointCast: capabilities, field notes, rules, and public receipts.
